mainText: Good morning. Wednesday, October 21. Futures are pointing modestly higher. S and P 500 futures are up about two to three tenths of a percent, Nasdaq futures are up about half a percent, and Dow futures are roughly flat. The drivers: SpaceX posted a big third quarter beat, fourteen point five eight billion dollars in revenue, up one hundred sixty one percent, and Elon Musk said a Tesla merger has a lot of merit. Super Micro raised its sales and margin outlook. The ten year Treasury yield sits near five point one two percent, little changed. Premarket movers: SpaceX up about nine percent, Super Micro up about twelve percent. On the downside, Netflix is down about six percent after cutting its twenty twenty six advertising outlook, and Intuitive Surgical is down about seven and a half percent. On deck after the close today: Meta and Tesla report earnings.
